16 October 2026-15 January 2027:
Apply and submit your supporting documents to universityadmissions.se as early as possible. Processing can take several weeks. If you apply close to the application deadline, you may not be notified about missing documents before the deadline for supporting documents.
All applicants are required to fill out a CV form that will be used in the selection process. Upload the CV form to your account at universityadmissions.se by the documentation deadline.
